Subject: Capacity ask — Zephyr initial signal for Q1 onramp

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Zephyr is targeting a phased onramp for our conversational product starting Jan 15 (pilot) and full launch Mar 1. We expect an initial steady-state of ~120 rps peak at launch across US+EU with APAC trailing by 6–8 weeks.

We need a committed pool for dedicated inference (GPU-backed) that guarantees latency and cost predictability. Can your team provide a proposed regional sizing and a short path to reserve capacity?

Key asks:
- Rough minimum committed GPUs by region (US / EU / APAC) for 120 rps peak at launch.
- Expected tail latency SLO vs cost tradeoffs (e.g., 8x A100 vs 4x A100 + quant).
- Timeline for provisioning and any lead time risks.

Attaching our high-level traffic projection (will follow with more granular traffic windows).

Procurement contact: procurement@zephyr.ai
Sanjay Rao
Head of Infrastructure, Zephyr AI

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the signal and the timeline. We're excited to partner on the Zephyr launch. To give you an actionable commitment we need a couple of clarifications that will feed our regional sizing model:

1) Can you confirm the expected average request size (tokens in/out) and the percent of requests that will require long-context (>=2048 tokens)?
2) Which model family are you planning to serve (open Llama variant / custom finetune / 3rd-party)? If you need recommendations we can map cost/lats across model variants.
3) Do you plan to use streaming or batched synchronous calls?

I've attached a short capacity-request-template.xlsx — if you fill the traffic windows and token profiles we'll produce a recommended SKU allocation per region and a 90/95 p99 latency estimate for each commit tier.

Next steps:
- Sanjay: fill template and return (procurement@zephyr.ai)
- Naomi/Ben: produce tri-region sizing & cost delta by Nov 1
- Internal: sync with Provisioning to confirm onramp lead times

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Capacity ask — initial tri-region sizing (draft)

Naomi — forwarding a draft sizing I ran after the call. See zephyr_capacity_matrix.csv attached. High level summary below (assumes 120 rps peak, 8 token avg request, model baseline: Llama-For-Inference-7B quantized):

- US: 8x GPU (A10G-equivalent) dedicated pool for steady-state. Burst + canary slices: +2 GPUs for first 4 weeks.
- EU: 6x GPU steady-state. Latency target p95 ~ 180ms with batching turned on.
- APAC: start with 3x GPU for pilot (pilot + edge region), scale to 6x by full launch +6 weeks.

Cost tradeoffs: moving to A100-80GB (higher perf) reduces GPU count by ~30% but increases unit hourly costs by ~2.1x — we recommend mixed SKUs for deterministic peak windows (US/EU) and smaller A10G-like instances for APAC pilot.

Lead time constraints: provisioning A100-capacity in EU during Jan has ~3–4 week lead time in our Dedicated offering; A10G-equivalent has a 1–2 week lead.

Actions I recommend we take now:
1) Lock a soft-commit for US/EU steady-state by Nov 8 to secure slots.
2) Offer a staged contract: 3-month pilot (APAC + canary) then expand to full steady-state with a 30-day notice.
3) Prep redwood_onramp_playbook.pdf for Zephyr's infra and security review.
